login.title: Sign in

login.studentHint: Students sign in with the account and password from their teacher.

invite.body: You're invited to AyaNote with {teacher}. Enter your student portal to see lessons, summaries, and homework.
invite.reuseHint: Bookmark this link or /student after signing in. The same invite works again if your session expires.
invite.expiredBody: Ask your teacher to regenerate the invite link.

today.title: Today
today.subtitle: Upcoming lessons with one-line context
today.startClassEmpty: No class to start in this window — approve a booking or open Calendar.

calendar.subtitle: Schedule in your timezone — week view or month grid

calendar.noStudents: No students yet — add one on the Students page first.
calendar.errConflict: That time conflicts with another lesson.
calendar.errSchedule: Could not book that slot. Pick another time or student.

students.title: Students
students.subtitle: Profiles, timeline, and progress
students.name: Name
students.passwordHint: Share the site URL + this account + password with the student.
students.passwordNewHint: Leave blank to keep the current password. Fill in to set a new one to share.
students.loginCredsHint: Give the student the website URL, account, and password (no invite link).
students.inviteHint: Reusable invite link — student clicks to sign into their portal (summary & homework).

lessonRoom.title: Lesson Room
lessonRoom.subtitle: After Classroom · scan highlights · approve memory
lessonRoom.placeholder: Paste a transcript here if needed…
lessonRoom.classroomHint: Teach in AyaNote Classroom (LiveKit). End & transcribe builds this summary — paste only if needed.
lessonRoom.okLivekit: Classroom audio transcribed and summarized. Review below.
lessonRoom.manualFallback: Prefer End & transcribe in Classroom. Paste here only as a fallback.
lessonRoom.regenNote: A summary already exists — submitting will regenerate it.
lessonRoom.todaySummaryHint: 2–4 sentences on what you practiced — keep it scannable.
lessonRoom.nextDirectionHint: Where to go next — Prep can reuse this directly.
lessonRoom.noExamples: No example sentences yet — regenerate with AI.
lessonRoom.aiMissing: AI key missing ({provider}) — local heuristic only
lessonRoom.okSummary: Summary generated. Review and approve below.
lessonRoom.generatingBody: Transcribing classroom audio and drafting the lesson summary. This page will update when ready.
lessonRoom.generatingFailed: Summary is taking too long. Paste a transcript below as a fallback, or reopen Classroom and try End & transcribe again.
lessonRoom.warnNoAiKey: No AI API key on server — summary used a local heuristic. Set DEEPSEEK_API_KEY for better results.
lessonRoom.warnHeuristic: AI summary did not complete — this is a local fallback (raw-ish topics / empty vocab). Retry AI summary below.
lessonRoom.retryAiSummary: Retry AI summary from stored transcript
lessonRoom.hwTextOnly: Text homework (no quiz — need ≥3 vocab items)

prep.title: Prep Queue
prep.subtitle: Prepare each student’s next lesson — switch students, then edit one section at a time
prep.empty: No upcoming lessons to prep. Approve bookings or wait for students to book.
prep.noDraft: Generate a draft or write notes for this section…
prep.generateDone: Drafts ready — review references below, then mark ready before class.
prep.vocabRecallHint: Shown as ＿＿(hint). Ask the student to fill the blank; hover the blank to reveal the answer.
prep.placeholderLine1: Pulling course track, goals, and level…
prep.placeholderLine2: Reading recent lesson summaries & next focus…
prep.placeholderLine3: Mixing vocab bank and weak points into sections…

availability.title: Availability
availability.subtitle: Rules for student booking — 1 hour lessons, starts at :00 or :30

settings.stt: Capture: Classroom End & transcribe (Whisper/Deepgram), or paste a transcript in Lesson Room.
settings.privacy: Students see summaries and homework only by default.
